import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [0] * 10000
    for _ in range(n):
        t_val = int(next(it))
        a[t_val] += 1
    t = int(next(it))
    i = 1
    ans = 0
    while i <= 1000:
        cur = 0
        for j in range(i, i + t + 1):
            cur += a[j]
        if cur > ans:
            ans = cur
        i += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
